A silent video with step-by-step captions. It works offline, and you can replay it at any time. Follow the steps on your own phone to finish setup.

Open Keyboard setup in AI Reply.
In Android settings, find AI Reply in the on-screen keyboard list.
Enable AI Reply, then select it as your keyboard. A separate clipboard permission is not required.
Copy a message, switch to AI Reply, then tap a recipient or Paste. Text is read only after your tap.
The video follows the app language. It uses your phone language unless you choose another language in AI Reply settings.
Connect the keyboard
Open the Android on-screen keyboard settings and turn on AI Reply. Read and confirm the system warning if you want to use the keyboard.
Return to AI Reply and select it in the keyboard picker. In a chat, tap the message field and switch to AI Reply using the keyboard switcher.
Reply to a copied message
In your chat, press and hold the message you want to answer, then choose Copy.
Open the chat message field, switch to AI Reply and tap a recipient or “%1$s”. Check that the copied message appears in the reply panel.
Android has no separate clipboard permission to enable. AI Reply reads copied text when you tap a recipient or Paste message.
Create, check and insert
Choose who you are writing to and add an instruction if needed, such as “Reply briefly and politely”. You can type it or use the microphone.
Tap “%1$s” to create a reply. To write a new message, open AI, describe what you need and tap “%2$s”. An internet connection is required.
Read the result. Edit it or request another version if needed.
Tap “%1$s” to place the result in the chat message field.
Check the message in your chat, then send it yourself using the chat app’s Send button.
Use voice input
The microphone is optional. You can always enter the instruction with the keyboard.
Tap the microphone in the instruction panel. If Android asks, allow microphone access when you want to dictate. If access is off, enable it in Android Settings → Apps → AI Reply → Permissions.
Speak your instruction, then tap “%1$s” to finish recording and recognize the words.
Check the recognized text in the instruction and correct it before generating. When dictating directly into a chat field, use Insert if the words are waiting for confirmation.
Voice input needs an internet connection. Your recording goes through the AI Reply server to OpenAI to be turned into text.
